day_local: Isniinta Todobaadkii Soddomaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan dhammaantiin.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.
homily:
Bal ka fikir subax ay qorraxdu soo baxdo, oo daaqadda qolka uu ka muuqdo buug furan oo ay ku qoran yihiin xisaab iyo fikrado farsamo. Waa shay caadi ah. Waa calaamad muujinaysa in qof uu halkan joogay, in maskax firfircoon ay shaqaynaysay, in qof uu dunida ka eegayay indho wax dhisaya oo la yaab leh. Marka qof uu maqnaado, shaygaas yari wuxuu noqdaa mid culus, mid xusuusinaya booska banaan. Laakiin maanta, ma joogno kaliya inaan eegno banaanraaca, ee waxaan joognaa inaan maqlo codka nolosha inoo yeeraya.

Waxaan maanta qaadaneynaa hal sawir oo laga keenay akhriska: sawirka geedka ku taagan biyaha socda, kaas oo soo saara midhihiisa xilligii munaasabka ahaa, oo caleemihiisu aysan abid engegin. Bal u fiirso geedkaas. Ma aha geed ku dhex nool dhul qalalan oo qorraxdu gubayso; waa mid xididdadiisu hoos u galaan oo helaya biyo aan waligood go'ayn. Nolosha bini'aadamka, marka la eego dusha sare, mararka qaarkood waxay u egtahay mid go'an, mid la dhibtoonaysa culeyska maalinta. Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu ina siinayaa meel aan ku nasano, meel xididdadeennu ay ka helaan nafaqo.

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aan caadi ahayn. Waxaan ognahay sida uu u jeclaa inuu barto waxyaabaha waaweyn—sida uu u darsanayay nidaamyada AWS, u qorayay koodhka GitHub, iyo sida uu u dhisayay riyadiisa ku saabsan 'con chim airlines', shirkadda diyaaradeed ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Wuxuu ahaa wiil indhihiisu ay eegayeen cirka, oo jeclaa diyaaradaha iyo inuu adduunka arko. Laakiin waxa ka sii weynaa maskaxdiisa fiiqan wuxuu ahaa qalbigiisii jilicsanaa. Xusuusnow markii uu dhowr sano ka hor, isagoo da' yar, uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa hibo aan la soo koobi karin. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka qalbiga wanaagsan.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka gurigu aamuso, ama marka habeenkii la gaaro, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara booskaas banaan. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan si jilicsan oo naxariis leh idiin xusuusiyo: xanuunkan iyo dhibaatadan midkoodna ma aha khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay Injiilka maanta ka soo galaysaa qolka mugdiga ah. Waxaan aragnaa naagtiii siddeed iyo toban sano la xidhnaa, oo laba laabantay oo aan kor u eegi karin. Ciise wuxuu u yeedhay iyada, wuxuuna ku yiri: 'Naag yahay, waxaad ka xorowday cudurkaaga.' Oo isla markiiba way is taagtay oo way ammaantay Ilaah. Hogaamiyihii sunagiguna wuxuu ka xanaaqay inuu Ciise bogsiiyay maalinta Sabtida. Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku jawaabay: 'Miya uusan mid kasta oo idinka mid ahi maalinta Sabtida furin dibigigiisa ama dameerkiisa... oo uu kaxeeyo si uu u waraabiyo? Gabadhan Ibraahim, oo Shaydaanku xidhay siddeed iyo toban sano, miyaanay habboonayn in la xoreeyo maanta?' Halkan waxaa ah in xorriyaddu ay timaado marka jacaylka Ilaah uu jabiyo silsiladaha.

Benjamin wuxuu hadda joogaa xorriyaddaas buuxda. Ma jiro wax xidhaya, ma jiro xanuun dambe. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ah meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, oo dhoola caddaynaya. Sida uu ku yiri riyadii uu aabbihiis la wadaagay: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si heer sare ah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaada, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in xididdadaadu ay ku dhex yaalliin biyaha nool ee Ilaah, kuwaas oo aan marnaba engegin. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise sowjalkayga Quduuska ah, waxaan rumeeyay inaad ku sugan tahay Sakramenta Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclaa wax kasta, waxaana jeclaan lahaa inaan naftayda ku soo dhoweeyo. Maaddaama aanan hadda heli karin Sakramenta, fadlan ku soo gal qalbigayga si ruuxaan ah. Waxaan kuu duubayaa sida adigoo halkaan jooga oo kale, mana oggolaan doono inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo; Rabbigu ha u jeediyo wajigiisa dhankiinna, oo ha idin naxariisto. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: In Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan intii naftooda dhiibtay ay ku nastaan nuurka iyo nabadda Masiixa, aan tukano.
In dhammaan kuwa la ildaran murugada iyo cidlooyinka ay helaan qaboojin iyo rajada Ilaah, aan tukano.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaow, midkiinba midka kale ha u roonaado, oo ha u naxariisto, oo midkiinba midka kale ha cafin, siduu Ilaahna Masiixu idiinku cafiyay oo kale. Haddaba u ekaada Ilaah, sida carruurtiisa aadka u jecel, oo jacayl ku dhex socda, sidii Masiixu noo jeclaaday oo uu naftiisa noogu bixiyayayd qurbaan udgoon oo Ilaah loo soo bandhigay. Sinada ama wax kasta oo nijaas ah ama hami xun yaanu xitaa magiciinnu ku dhex xusmin, sida ku habboon dadka quduuska ah, oo ha la maqlin wax cay ah ama hadal doqonimo ah ama mid xun oo aan munaasib ahayn, laakiin waxaa ka wanaagsan mahadnaq. Xaqiiqsanow inaan nin sinaysta ah ama nijaas ah ama hami xun leh, oo ah sanam caabude, uusan dhaxal ku lahayn Boqortooyada Masiixa iyo tan Ilaah. Qofna yaanu idinku kadsoobin eryo madhan, waayo waxyaalahan awgeed ayay cadhadii Ilaah ugu soo degtaa kuwa aan adeecin. Sidaa darteed ha la jirin kuwaas. Waayo mar ayaad mugdi ahaydeen, laakiin hadda waxaad tihiin nuur Rabbiga dhexdiisa ah. Sida carruurta nuurka u socda.

readings.label: Sabuurka Jawaabta
readings.text:
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.

Baarakaysan yahay ninkii aan ku socon talada kuwa xunxun,
Oo aan ku taagnayn jidka dembiilayaasha,
Oo aan fadhiisan fadhiga kuwa wax quudhsada,
Laakiin sharciga Rabbigu uu ka helo farxad,
Oo uu sharcigiisa ka fekero habeen iyo maalin.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.

Wuxuu la mid yahay geed
Biyaha socda agtooda lagu beeray,
Kaas oo midhihiisa soo saara xilligooda,
Oo caleemihiisu aysan abid engegin,
Oo wax kasta uu sameeyo ay u barakeysan yihiin.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.

Saas ma aha kuwa xunxun, saas ma aha;
Waxay la mid yihiin qolof dabayshu kaxayso.
Waayo Rabbigu wuxuu ilaaliyaa jidka kuwa xaq ah,
Laakiin jidka kuwa xunxun wuu baaba'aa.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise ayaa sunagigii wax ku barayay maalinta Sabtida. Waxaa halkaas joogtay naag soddon iyo toban sano ruux cudur ku hayay, oo laba laabantay, oo aan weligeed kor u eegi karin. Markuu Ciise arkay ayuu u yeedhay oo ku yiri, 'Naag yahay, waxaad ka xorowday cudurkaaga.' Gacmihiisa ayuu saaray, oo isla markiiba way is taagtay, oo waxay ammaantay Ilaah. Laakiin hoggaamiyihii sunagigii, oo ka cadhooday in Ciise uu bogsiiyay maalinta Sabtida, ayaa dadkii ku yiri, 'Waxaa jira lix maalmood oo ay tahay in shaqada la qabto; maalmahaas yimaada oo ha la idin bogsiiyo, ee yaan la imanin maalinta Sabtida.' Rabbigu wuxuu ugu jawaabay oo ku yiri, 'Munaafaqyoow, miyaanu mid kasta oo idinka mid ahi maalinta Sabtida furin dibigigiisa ama dameerkiisa oo ka kaxayn meesha cuntada si uu u waraabiyo? Gabadhan Ibraahim, oo Shaydaanku xidhay siddeed iyo toban sano, miyaanay habboonayn in laga furo xariggaas maalinta Sabtida?' Markuu erayadaas yidhi, dhammaan cadowgiisii way ceeboobeen, dadkiina oo dhammu waxay ku farxeen falimaha waaweyn ee uu sameeyay.

day: Monday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
